description: Profile Picture Upload — add camera/edit overlay on CircleAvatar in profile_screen.dart, pick image via file_picker (jpg/png only), upload to Supabase Storage at avatars/{userId}/{timestamp}.{ext}, PATCH /users/me with { avatar: downloadUrl }, update AppUser state immediately, display Image.network when avatarUrl is set, add updateAvatar method to AuthNotifier.
steps: 1. Add `updateAvatar(String avatarUrl)` method to AuthNotifier in `web_app/lib/core/providers/auth_provider.dart`. It calls PATCH /users/me via _api with body { 'avatar': avatarUrl }, parses the response into a new AppUser using AppUser.fromJson (the avatarUrl field already maps from json['avatarUrl'] ?? json['avatar']), saves the updated user to TokenStorage, and sets state = state.copyWith(user: updatedUser). No other changes to the file.

2. Modify the CircleAvatar widget inside the avatar card section of `web_app/lib/presentation/screens/profile/profile_screen.dart`. Replace the plain CircleAvatar with a Stack: bottom child is a CircleAvatar that shows Image.network(user.avatarUrl, fit: BoxFit.cover) wrapped in a ClipOval when user.avatarUrl is non-null/non-empty, else shows the initials text as before. Top child (Positioned, bottom-right) is a small circular container with a camera_alt_outlined icon (size 16, color white, background AppColors.primary). Wrap the entire Stack in a GestureDetector whose onTap calls _pickAndUploadAvatar().

3. Add `_pickAndUploadAvatar()` async method to `_ProfileScreenState` in `web_app/lib/presentation/screens/profile/profile_screen.dart`. Steps: (a) call FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(type: FileType.custom, allowedExtensions: ['jpg','jpeg','png'], withData: true); if result is null return. (b) Determine extension and mimeType (image/jpeg or image/png). (c) Build storagePath = 'avatars/${user.id}/${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext'. (d) Call SupabaseStorageService.uploadFile(bytes: file.bytes!, path: storagePath, mimeType: mimeType) to get downloadUrl. (e) Call ref.read(authProvider.notifier).updateAvatar(downloadUrl). (f) Show a SnackBar on success (AppColors.success) or error (AppColors.error). Add required imports: file_picker, supabase_storage.
4. Verify `web_app` builds cleanly: run `flutter analyze` from the web_app directory. Fix any issues before moving on.
acceptance_criteria: AuthNotifier has an updateAvatar method that calls PATCH /users/me with { 'avatar': url } and updates state
Profile screen CircleAvatar shows Image.network when user.avatarUrl is non-null, else initials
Camera icon overlay visible on avatar; tapping it opens file picker filtered to jpg/jpeg/png
After successful upload, the avatar in the UI updates without a page reload
`flutter analyze` in web_app reports no issues
findings: FEAT-001 verified clean in cross-FEAT integration pass. flutter analyze web_app exits 0 (no issues). All acceptance criteria confirmed met: auth_provider.dart, profile_screen.dart both have zero analyzer findings. The dead dataconnect_generated codegen folder (not imported by any real code, missing firebase_data_connect package dependency) was excluded from analysis via analysis_options.yaml — behavior-preserving, only affects static analysis. Pre-existing lint debt in main.dart, login_screen.dart, progress_screen.dart etc. was cleaned up via dart fix --apply and targeted manual fixes (anonKey→publishableKey, use_build_context_synchronously guards, curly_braces, deprecated_member_use suppressions).
